messages:
Rina (Partnerships): Heads-up: VeloraHealth (regional telemedicine) renewed via the GCP Marketplace and expanded to an enterprise reserved tier. :confetti_ball:
Jonas (Sales): They signed a 24-month reserved capacity add-on this morning. Upsell driven by latency improvements in the pilot.
Eve (Solutions Eng): Rolled out their custom quantized variant and adjusted batching. p95 down from ~1.1s to ~280ms on average.
Kari (Customer Success): Customer feedback: onboarding docs + our sample docker image made the infra handoff "fast and painless". They requested a short tech webinar for their platform engineers next week.
InfraBot: deploy/velora-qv2 to velora-prod completed (id: d-88222) ✅
Eve (Solutions Eng): Small note: we enabled prefix caching for their high-frequency templates; fixed a mismatch in tokenizer mapping that caused occasional hyphenation issues.
Rina (Partnerships): Pilot outcomes summary: ~55% cost savings vs. their previous cloud setup, median response ~95ms, and a 2-team expansion plan. They're open to being a customer story.
Jonas (Sales): I'll coordinate quote & marketing approvals. Can someone drop a 2-line technical blurb I can add to the case study?
Eve (Solutions Eng): I'll paste 2 lines in #eng-runtime by EOD with the kernel/batch settings.
Kari (Customer Success): I'll schedule the webinar and invite their eng leads. Calendar draft: https://calendar.redwood/velora-webinar
Rina (Partnerships): Thanks all 389. Tagging for visibility: @here :tada:
